The image displays a dark green, elongated leaf with numerous small, roughly circular, whitish-to-light-tan spots scattered across its upper surface. The spots appear slightly raised or crusty, consistent with the growth of a fungal colony on the leaf surface. This pattern of distinct, superficial, whitish patches is characteristic of Powdery Mildew.
